tower.notes: 부천시 상징탑 stands in the central plaza/lawn at the park centre, south of this photo (estimated around (430,2430) extrapolated from OSM's central oval walk 472050737; not in the 2304 px image). No published height found; ~30-35 m estimated from photos (several times tree height, below the 20-storey apartments behind). A large white 'BUCHEON' letter sign stands on the plaza nearby.

stage.notes: 야외음악당 not in this photo. Aerial photo (saebucheon.com) shows a white ribbed shell / half-dome bandshell in the big central lawn between the twin domes and the symbol tower, i.e. south of y 2304. Text sources describe a round light-green roof; the aerial shows white. Size is a rough estimate.

notes: Only the north third of 부천중앙공원 lies inside this photo: the grid of lawns and paved walks on the west (tree/grass side), the twin glass geodesic domes, two toilets with small domes, six white-framed underground-parking entrances, the diagonal tree-lined promenade and the start of the east water side (dark pond, teal stream channel, tan paths). The symbol tower, the 야외음악당 shell stage, the central oval lawn, the big fountain/pond with island and the 능소화 tunnel are south of y 2304 and need the cell to the south. Path widths from OSM width tags where present, otherwise measured. Pixel coordinates are traced from the photo; OSM geometry is offset 10-40 px in places (its NW diagonal walk does not match the curved arc seen in the photo). No web image was saved.
